named_mechanism: Catalog-level waveform accuracy characterization for SXS-like numerical relativity outputs
definition: Summarize distributions of synthetic waveform discrepancies associated with numerical resolution, harmonic mode content, and extrapolation order.
assumptions: Each row represents one synthetic simulation-level summary statistic.
Values are already minimally time- and phase-aligned differences as described in the task.
The synthetic datasets are intended to reproduce qualitative trends from the SXS catalog paper rather than exact published values.
invariants: Use positive-valued distribution summaries appropriate for heavy-tailed errors.
Preserve harmonic index structure l=2..8 in at least one output artifact.
Preserve separate extrapolation comparisons N2vsN3 and N2vsN4 in at least one output artifact.
structural_steps: Compute robust summaries on original and log10 scales
Estimate high-tail exceedance fractions for quality assessment
Generate direct comparison plots for distributions and modal trends
Document limitations from using synthetic summary data instead of raw waveforms
